# XMP metadata fixtures

Published files that carry `KHR_xmp_json_ld`, unchanged. Source, commit and licence of each are in the supply-chain record, `THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md`.

- `XmpMetadataRoundedCube.glb`: Khronos glTF-Sample-Assets, CC-BY-4.0, Adam Morris.
- `Box.gltf`, `Box0.bin`, `language-alternatives.gltf`, `language-attribute.gltf`: the examples of KhronosGroup/glTF-Metadata-CLI, CC-BY-4.0, The Khronos Group. The last two are its `edge-cases/*/Box.gltf`.
- `boom_box.gltf`: the JSON of omigroup/gltf-extensions `KHR_audio_emitter/examples/boom_box`, CC0-1.0 by its own metadata, The Khronos Group.
- `rocket_ship.gltf`: the JSON of omigroup/gltf-extensions `OMI_vehicle_thruster/examples`, CC-BY-3.0 by its own metadata, Poly by Google and aaronfranke.

The buffers and textures of the last two stay out of the repository: the test reads only their metadata.
